inlines.v: RELAXA'TION, noun [Latin relaxatio.] 1. The act of slackening or remitting tension; as a relaxation of the muscles, fibers or nerves; a relaxation of the whole system. 2. Cessation of restraint. 3. Remission or abatement of rigor; as a relaxation of the law. 4. Remission of attention or application; as a relaxation of mind, study or business. 5. An opening or loosening.
